rules.anchor: None of these provided? Ask before proceeding.

rules.anchor: never assume without confirming
rules.why: tickets are drafted with the user

rules.anchor: you MUST be on main with latest pulled

rules.anchor: Never cite one you not asked about.

rules.anchor: it is the implementer's call

rules.anchor: it goes alone

rules.anchor: show it before writing
rules.why: a relocation shows the exact spec text in the same response

rules.anchor: Relocated, never deleted, and never overwritten
